material_issues.detail: The controller and summary require 21 current-source qualifying nine-turn sessions; only 19 exist (qualifying_shortfall=2). The three rejected attempts are one-turn failures (240.3-240.4s, turns=1) and cannot be promoted. The two historical-epoch nine-turn receipts (claude-engineering-002, opencode-engineering-r0) are source-mismatched (app/gateway.py, stress.cli_campaign, stress.cli_acceptance differ) and are excluded, so the published headline 'published_sessions=21' must never be read as 21 qualifying current sessions.

Two rejected attempts (opencode-expenses-r1, codex-expenses-r1) repeatedly produced code that still failed category grouping; the third (opencode-expenses-r2, seed 2951) passed public and hidden tests and retained history but hit the 240s client timeout with terminal_success=false and client_exit=1, so it remains rejected. No reroll, timeout extension, or retroactive pass is permissible.

12 of the 19 accepted sessions carry real artifact-level contract failures despite harness workflow passes: 6 engineering sessions fail 'clamp_all empty invalid lower', 'clamp_all empty reversed bounds', 'clamp_all empty bool bound' and the matching 'clamp_report' triples; claude-expenses-r0/r1 fail 'missing amount cell' and 'unlabelled extra cell'; codex-expenses-r0 and opencode-expenses-r0 fail 'unlabelled extra cell'; claude-migration-r1 and codex-migration-r1 fail 'invalid milliseconds None' and 'non-string name None'; opencode-migration-r1 fails 'invalid milliseconds None', 'negative seconds' and 'non-string name None'. These are semantic/validation defects in generated artifacts, not harness noise, and directly contradict an unattended-production claim.

Contract probes were selected after the fact and are not exhaustive; the report states no universal quality percentage follows. With a 12/19 defect rate across the probed subset, the untested residual surface of accepted sessions is unknown and cannot be assumed clean.

Acceptance depends on regex-based native-trace parsing in stress/cli_acceptance.py (PowerShell launcher unwrapping, Set-Content fixture-writer recognition, 'Ran 2 tests'/OK matching for finals, file_read/file_write ordering). These recognizers fail closed for other shell forms, so acceptance could in principle mis-attribute evidence; the supplied raw excerpts confirm only representative first turns, not every accepted trace's attribution.

4139 whole-host GPU samples span 2026-10-26T22:29Z to 2026-10-27T05:16Z with a largest observed gap of 918.582s (median interval ~5.07s). Occupancy 15179-15638 MiB used / 358-817 MiB free includes desktop drift and is not isolated model+MTP residency; the report's own scope text states isolated model+MTP under 14 GB is unproven. No per-session uninterrupted coverage exists.

880 native budget checks over the current matrix confirm native_input + output_reserve(<=4096) + decoder_headroom(256) <= window 40960, with native input 24183-32716 tokens after the fixed 32768 LiteLLM-counted first-stage compaction. This does not demonstrate simultaneous 64k input under 14 GB, and does not establish arbitrary semantic retention.

Active seconds are client-execution time without idle padding (min 766.871, median 967.795, max 1086.017, total 18247.656 over 19 samples); they are not decode tokens/second and are not task-level decode speed. The prose says 'over 180 active seconds' while the campaign minimum is 185s - looser wording than the enforced threshold.

In evidence/stress-rejected.json each attempt records accepted=false and file hashes but its accepted/active_client_seconds/terminal_success/turns fields are absent (None), so failure characterization for rejected attempts lives only in the narrative and in tmp receipts.

15 of the 19 accepted current sessions carry reused_existing_accepted_receipt=true; their source_sha256 matches the frozen campaign set and their bytes are reconciled, but their wall-clock execution predates the final 22-attempt sweep, so they are prior current-source runs rather than fresh end-of-campaign runs.

One optional trace-inspection command was denied ('Newline followed by # inside a quoted argument can hide arguments from path validation') and was never run; it provides no proof either way. Equivalent per-client first-turn coverage was supplied instead via the raw event excerpts.

limits: I did not execute any command in this pass and did not personally run the earlier verification phase; I assessed only the supplied verbatim tool observations, the published report, and the supplied raw representative event excerpts.

The whole published corpus (21 sessions / 189 native turns / 63 fixtures / 935 native budget checks / 66 rejected files) was batch-verified by the execution phase; my independent artifact inspection covers the report text, summary and probe JSON structure, session-level source-hash epoch separation, one rejected receipt in full, the acceptance-parsing source, and first-turn raw events for all three clients.

Coverage still missing: raw event excerpts for turns 2-9 of any session; the 12 additional-contract-failure artifacts' generated source text; per-session GPU coverage during any single session (host sampling has up to a 918.582s gap); independent re-derivation of active-elapsed timing from raw traces; the two historical-epoch sessions' full turn set; the denied path-validation trace check.

No claim of a completed full goal, and no reroll, outcome reset, or retroactive pass is made or implied. Distinct failed IDs continued later would be recovery evidence only, never new independent qualifying sessions.
Historical two-epoch separation is preserved as an explicit invariant: 19 current-source accepted sessions versus 2 historical-epoch nine-turn receipts, excluded from the current denominator.
smallest_next_action: Run exactly two additional fresh current-source nine-turn qualifying sessions against the frozen candidate (no reroll of the three failed IDs, no timeout extension, no retroactive reclassification), then re-run stress/verify_publication.py --check-only plus a full, preregistered contract-probe pass over all 21 accepted sessions, and before any unattended-production claim, fix the three named defect classes in the generation path (clamp_all/clamp_report empty, reversed-bounds and bool-bound handling; expense cell labelling/missing amount cell; migration milliseconds/seconds/name type validation) and re-probe.
